"Happy" is a song performed by British singer Leona Lewis for her second studio album Echo (2009).

It was written by Lewis, Ryan Tedder, Evan Bogart, and produced by Tedder, and it premiered on UK radio on 6 September 2009, and was officially released on 15 September 2009, by digital download in the U.S., serving as the album's lead single.
Lyrically, it talks about a protagonist, that wants to be happy and seize the day.
Echo is the second studio album by British singer Leona Lewis.
It was released on 9 November 2009 including 16 November in the United Kingdom, and 17 November 2009 in the United States.
Its worldwide release was through Sony Music.
